designationHistory.indexText: The Interior Department established Southern Maryland Woodlands National Wildlife Refuge in December 2024 when The Nature Conservancy donated a first 31-acre tract near Nanjemoy in Charles County, Maryland.

authority.citation: Secretary of the Interior; donation of first parcel by The Nature Conservancy

designationHistory.note: Pass A (FWS: established by the Secretary of the Interior on December 6, 2024, when the first parcel was donated; celebrated with Secretary Haaland on Friday, December 13, 2024) and Pass B (Baltimore Fishbowl, December 13, 2024: establishment announced, 31-acre parcel near Nanjemoy) agree on December 2024 and the first parcel. The exact day, December 6, rests on the FWS page alone, so only the month is given.
